name: Congenital Partial Anomalous Pulmonary Venous Return

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Partial Anomalous Pulmonary Venous Return Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Identification of one or more pulmonary veins draining into the systemic venous circulation instead of the left atrium
Presence of left-to-right shunting demonstrated by echocardiography or cardiac catheterization
Exclusion of total anomalous pulmonary venous return by imaging studies
Clinical signs such as exertional dyspnea or recurrent respiratory infections

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of anomalous pulmonary vein connection with evidence of left-to-right shunting on imaging
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily based on imaging modalities including echocardiography, cardiac MRI, or CT angiography.

pathognomonic.notes: Identified on imaging, definitive for diagnosis

searchTerms: blood flow from left to right heart

common.notes: Shortness of breath during physical activity

common.symptomName: Murmur due to increased pulmonary flow
searchTerms: heart murmur from extra lung blood flow
murmur due to increased lung circulation

occasional.notes: Rarely present due to minor right-to-left shunting

rare.notes: Develops in advanced or untreated cases
Peripheral edema, hepatomegaly in severe cases
searchTerms: swelling and fatigue from right heart failure

laboratory: Possible elevated brain natriuretic peptide (BNP) in heart strain
imaging: Echocardiography showing anomalous pulmonary vein drainage and left-to-right shunt
Cardiac MRI or CT angiography confirming partial anomalous pulmonary venous return
Chest X-ray showing cardiomegaly or increased pulmonary vascular markings
genetic: No specific genetic mutation identified; may be sporadic or associated with congenital syndromes
other: Electrocardiogram may show right atrial enlargement or right ventricular hypertrophy

distinguishingFeatures: No pulmonary veins connect to left atrium
Absence of anomalous pulmonary vein drainage
Left-to-right shunt through atrial septal defect
No anomalous pulmonary venous connection on imaging

references: Gatzoulis MA, et al. Diagnosis and management of partial anomalous pulmonary venous connection. Heart. 2020.
Orphanet: Partial anomalous pulmonary venous return anomaly. ORPHA:99124.
Mavroudis C, Backer CL. Anomalous pulmonary venous connections. Semin Thorac Cardiovasc Surg Pediatr Card Surg Annu. 2004.
